competing_explanation: The 40% figure could be a real effect, but the n=6 single-dose pilot without washout verification or CI is methodologically insufficient to establish the exact magnitude claimed.
hypothesis_statement: VERDICT: FALSE — the only record addressing C1 (B3) is a re-analysis of an underpowered 6-subject pilot with no washout verification, no confidence interval, and no powered study, so it cannot support the claim that RX-441 increases bioavailability by exactly 40% relative to reference.
predicted_outcome: A properly powered, validated crossover PK study would show a bioavailability difference whose point estimate and CI do not confirm a precise 40% gain as stated.
refutation_criterion: A validated, adequately powered study reporting a statistically supported 40% relative increase in AUC/Cmax with a tight CI around 40% would falsify this verdict.
